bun.role: default development runtime and packed consumer

deno.declaredSurface: Load the compiled ESM artifact from node_modules (BYONM), read plugin/rule/domain metadata, and expand typed configuration. Running the oxlint CLI under Deno is not part of the declared surface.

distribution.analysisClaim: Syntax and scope diagnostics only; type-aware Effect diagnostics are delegated to @effect/tsgo.

oxlint.scope: Generic built-in typed Oxlint rules via options.typeAware; custom JavaScript plugin rules do not receive type information.

effect.scope: Effect-specific type diagnostics and language-service features. Overlapping syntax-only diagnostics stay disabled when this plugin owns them.

typedCompanions.residual: The pinned companions expose no domain-aware general rule for arbitrary typed .then/.catch/.finally chains; that policy remains an explicit typed-analysis gap.
